tools.name: openphone_list_phone_numbers
tools.description: List the OpenPhone numbers in the workspace (id, number, name, formatted number, assigned users, restrictions). Usually the first call — most other tools need a phoneNumberId. OpenPhone REST: GET /phone-numbers.

tools.name: openphone_list_users
tools.description: List workspace users (id, email, name, role). Use to find a userId for scoping other calls. OpenPhone REST: GET /users.

tools.name: openphone_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts in the workspace, optionally filtered by external ids or sources. Returns each contact's default fields (name, company, emails, phone numbers) and custom fields. OpenPhone REST: GET /contacts.

tools.name: openphone_get_contact
tools.description: Get a single contact by its id, including default fields (name, company, role, emails, phone numbers) and custom fields. OpenPhone REST: GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: openphone_get_contact_custom_fields
tools.description: List the workspace's contact custom-field definitions (name, key, type). Use the returned keys when creating contacts with custom fields. OpenPhone REST: GET /contact-custom-fields.

tools.name: openphone_list_conversations
tools.description: List conversations (threads), most-recent activity first, optionally filtered by phone number(s), user, and created/updated date ranges. Each conversation has participants, assignee, and last-activity metadata. OpenPhone REST: GET /conversations.

tools.name: openphone_list_messages
tools.description: List messages in a conversation between one of your OpenPhone numbers and one or more participants. Returns text, direction, status and timestamps. OpenPhone REST: GET /messages.

tools.name: openphone_get_message
tools.description: Get a single message by its id (starts with 'AC'). OpenPhone REST: GET /messages/{id}.

tools.name: openphone_send_message
tools.description: Send an SMS/text message from one of your OpenPhone numbers to up to 10 recipients. WRITE ACTION — this actually sends a real text message (which may incur carrier cost and requires approved A2P 10DLC registration). OpenPhone REST: POST /messages.

tools.name: openphone_list_calls
tools.description: List calls between one of your OpenPhone numbers and a participant, newest first, optionally filtered by user and created date range. Returns direction, status, duration and timestamps. OpenPhone REST: GET /calls.

tools.name: openphone_get_call
tools.description: Get a single call by its id (starts with 'AC') — direction, status, duration, participants and timestamps. OpenPhone REST: GET /calls/{id}.

tools.name: openphone_get_call_summary
tools.description: Get the AI-generated summary and next steps for a call by its id. Availability depends on your plan and whether the call was summarized. OpenPhone REST: GET /call-summaries/{callId}.

tools.name: openphone_get_call_transcript
tools.description: Get the transcription for a call by its id — dialogue segments with speaker, text and timestamps, plus overall status and duration. OpenPhone REST: GET /call-transcripts/{id}.

tools.name: openphone_get_call_recordings
tools.description: Get the recordings for a call by its id — each with a URL, duration, start time and status. OpenPhone REST: GET /call-recordings/{callId}.

tools.name: openphone_list_webhooks
tools.description: List all webhooks configured in the workspace (id, url, events, status). Read-only inventory — this tool does not create or delete webhooks. OpenPhone REST: GET /webhooks.

tools.name: openphone_create_contact
tools.description: Create a new contact in the workspace. WRITE ACTION — this adds a persistent contact record. Emails and phoneNumbers are passed as simple string arrays and stored under default field labels. OpenPhone REST: POST /contacts.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: openphone_list_users, openphone_list_contacts, openphone_get_contact, openphone_list_conversations, openphone_list_messages, openphone_get_message, openphone_get_call_transcript, openphone_get_call_recordings, openphone_list_webhooks · Private data: openphone_list_contacts, openphone_get_contact, openphone_get_contact_custom_fields, openphone_create_contact · Public sink: openphone_list_users, openphone_send_message, openphone_create_contact · Destructive: openphone_list_webhooks.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: openphone_list_users, openphone_list_contacts, openphone_get_contact, openphone_list_conversations, openphone_list_messages, openphone_get_message, openphone_get_call_transcript, openphone_get_call_recordings, openphone_list_webhooks · Private data: openphone_list_contacts, openphone_get_contact, openphone_get_contact_custom_fields, openphone_create_contact · Public sink: openphone_list_users, openphone_send_message, openphone_create_contact · Destructive: openphone_list_webhooks

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
